description: This file defines the Search class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for case-sensitive and case-insensitive string search functionalities within spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: Provides static methods for performing case-sensitive and case-insensitive text searches within spreadsheet data, supporting array inputs for batch processing.

methods.name: sensitive
methods.description: Performs a case-sensitive search for a substring within a string or array of strings, returning the position or an error message if not found.

methods.name: insensitive
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for a substring within a string or array of strings, returning the position or an error message if not found.
